kit.intro: Deadline 26 November. Open the form, then copy each box below into it, from top to bottom. The two questions are optional in the form but worth filling in.

blocks.heading: Contact fields
blocks.note: Type these into the form, top to bottom. Each box has a Copy button.

fields.label: Address
fields.value: Flat 16, Block 9, 10th West Street, Mehrabi, North Sazeman Barname, Ayatollah Kashani

fields.label: Mobile
fields.hint: No leading zero. Keep IR (+98) selected in the form.

blocks.heading: Question 1, why this position (500 characters at most)

fields.label: Why are you interested in this position and project?
fields.value: I want to work on heart signals that matter for patients and make them run on small wearable devices. This project joins biosignal processing, embedded systems and physiology, with real participants and clinicians at Karolinska. My thesis was a small on-device model for older adults, so a wearable for the heart is a natural next step, and I would like to learn the cardiovascular side from a group that has done it for years.

blocks.heading: Question 2, what you can contribute (500 characters at most)

fields.label: What can you contribute to the project and the research group?
fields.value: I bring embedded and signal processing experience. I built a small real-time model for a Raspberry Pi with a C++ front end, and worked out why it behaved differently on the real device than in testing. I test on unseen data and say where a model fails. I write Python, C++ and PyTorch. My thesis led to three papers, one accepted at ICBME 2026, one submitted to IEEE Sensors Journal and one to ICEE 2027. I have not worked with heart recordings yet and would learn them quickly.
